format: subway/1. Indexes are 0-based. routes{id:{short,long,color,text,line?}} hex colours without #; line = the train riders see for a diamond express variant (6X -> 6). Colours are the classic MTA bullet colours. feed={version,start,end} YYYYMMDD service range. complexes[i]={name,lat,lon,routes:[daytime route ids],ada:0|1|2 partly}. stops[j]={id:GTFS parent stop,c:complex index,lat,lon,name (platform name if part of the complex name, else the complex name),routes,ns:[N platform label,S platform label],nsr?:{route:[N,S]} per-line labels where a line runs the other way ("" = none),ada,adn?:note}. entrances[]={c (= stops[s].c),s?:stop index,lat,lon,type:stair|elevator|escalator|easement|ramp|door,ada?:1 step-free,x?:1 exit only,nx?:1 no exit}. patterns[]={route,dir:N|S,headsign,stops:[stop idx],run:[s from leaving stops[k] to leaving stops[k+1]],tph:{wk,sa,su}:[24]} where tph[h] = trips leaving the pattern's FIRST stop in NY clock hour h (wk=Mon-Fri). Trains/hour at stops[k] at time T: t=T-sum(run[0..k-1]) s (may be the previous day); n=tph[dayType(t)][hour(t)]. Sum n over patterns serving both stops in order; n=0 means not running. transfers[]=[fromStop,toStop,min s] (same stop: change time). hops{"a-b" a<b stop idx}=[lat0,lon0,dlat,dlon,...] ints 1e-5 deg, first pair absolute, then deltas; track from stops[a] to stops[b]; missing: straight line.
